name: ten interacting hysterons with competing couplings
question: How many distinguishable states does a frustrated network of hysterons gain over its balanced counterpart, and does the counterpart restore the return to every turning point?
assumptions: Ten bistable elements with loops of their own, coupled pairwise and reciprocally
A random graph of mean degree 4; coupling magnitudes 0.6 times a uniform factor between 0.5 and 1.5, with a fraction 0.75 of the couplings negative (competing)
Fields Gaussian with width 0.7, half-widths uniform between 0.05 and 0.8, rounded to three decimals
A uniform drive changing slowly; avalanches relaxed least stable element first

provenance.source: interacting hysterons: M. van Hecke, Phys. Rev. E 104, 054608 (2021); balance of a signed graph: F. Harary, Michigan Math. J. 2, 143 (1953); network drawn with seed 1
